label: Diagram 3.3
caption: Diagram 3.3 Floor type 1.1C – floor type 1.1 with ceiling treatment C
description: The image is headed "Diagram 3.3 Floor type 1.1C – floor type 1.1 with ceiling treatment C". Below the heading is a box containing a section, labelled "SECTION" at its lower right. The section shows a horizontal floor build‑up: a thick upper layer drawn with a dense stippled texture, resting on three small square support blocks, each marked with a diagonal cross; beneath these blocks runs a thin horizontal band formed by two parallel lines. No dimensions are shown. Below the box is a block of running text numbered "3.30", headed "Floor Type 1.2B Concrete planks (solid or hollow), soft floor covering, ceiling treatment B (see Diagram 3.4)", followed by five bullet points reading: "minimum mass per unit area of planks and any bonded screed of 365kg/m²"; "use a regulating floor screed"; "all floor joints fully grouted to ensure air tightness"; "soft floor covering essential"; "ceiling treatment B (or better) essential".
